segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Dave found two percent cashback. His brain immediately became a casino. He almost bought an eighty-dollar gadget he did not need.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Yes. One dollar and sixty cents. Congratulations, Dave. You spent eighty dollars to summon this.

segments.speaker: points_monk
segments.text: Would you buy it without the reward?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: If no, the reward won. Cashback only wins when the purchase already made sense. Buy first. Reward second.
